text:
She passes silently, and her movements
are a silent harmony;
her footsteps sound, and their sound recalls
the rhythmic cadence of a winged hymn.

She half opens her eyes, those eyes
as clear as day;
and earth and sky, all they encompass,
burn with new light in her pupils.

She laughs, and her laughter holds the notes
of running water;
she weeps, and every tear is a poem
of infinite tenderness.

She has the light, the fragrance,
the color and the line,
the form that gives birth to desire;
the expression, eternal source of poetry.

Is she stupid?... Bah! So long as she keeps
the riddle dark by keeping silent,
what she leaves unsaid will always be worth more,
to me, than anything another woman tells me.

translation.title: Rhyme XXXIV: She Passes Silently
